column2: [intro]
Productivity's not my creed,
I prefer to take my time, indeed.
Working non-stop, I leave that be,
To savor the moment, just being free.
I’m lazy, but I’m content,
My tranquility’s not a lament.
In idleness, I find the grace,
In leisure, I embrace my space.
Ambitions fierce and consuming,
Leave me weary, not amusing.
I prefer a life more serene,
Where happiness isn't a grand scene.
I’m lazy, but I’m content,
My tranquility’s not a lament.
In idleness, I find the grace,
In leisure, I embrace my space.
[ solo ]
Lazy yet in good health,
I choose to live my way, myself.
In a world that's rushed and fast,
I opt for a life that's meant to last.
[outro]
